title: Parameter file of tpg-delete-apps
description: The parameter file of `argo submit --from workflowtemplate/tpg-delete-apps --parameter-file`: the inputs of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-delete-apps. Generated from workflows/params/types.yaml and the template by workflows/params/params_schema.py. The shape, the types, the allowed values and the mandatory inputs; the validate step of the workflow and the admission policy tpg-workflow-parameters remain the authority (inputs that are mandatory in some cases only, combinations, registered clusters, the inside of clusterMap).

clusters.description: List: registered clusters to clean up, in brackets, [aks-tpg-poc-01] (also with one value) (without clusterMap) [List; mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

apps.description: Map (JSON) of cluster to applications (without clusterMap). Applications: tpg-instances (all instances), tpg-instances:<instance> (one element per instance), tpg-operator (operator and CRDs). Example: {"aks-tpg-poc-01":["tpg-instances","tpg-operator"],"aks-tpg-poc-02":["tpg-instances:orders-db","tpg-instances:billing-db"]} [Map (JSON); mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

clusterMap.description: Map (YAML or JSON): cluster -> {deleteOperator, force, instances: {instance -> {purgePvcs, purgeNamespace, purgeBackups, finalBackup}}}; the inputs below are the defaults [Map]

confirm.description: List in brackets: repeat the clusters value, or the cluster names of clusterMap, for example [aks-tpg-poc-01] [List; mandatory]

dryRun.description: true: record what would be deleted; false: delete [Boolean]

purgePvcs.description: true: delete PVCs and their Azure disks (irreversible); false: keep them. With clusterMap: the default of purgePvcs [Boolean; mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

purgeNamespace.description: true: delete the instance namespaces (needs purgePvcs=true; refused while another instance uses the namespace, except with deleteOperator); false: keep them [Boolean; mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

purgeBackups.description: true: expire every PostgresBackup of each instance while it runs, then delete the blobs left under its container and repoPath (irreversible; refused with finalBackup true or required; a repoPath another backup location uses keeps its blobs). With clusterMap: the default of purgeBackups [Boolean]

pushMode.description: direct: push to the fleet branch; pr: open a pull request and continue after it is merged [Enum; mandatory]

force.description: tpg-operator: also delete Postgres instances not listed, and do not wait for running backups or restores [Boolean]

forceDeleteStuckApps.description: true: an Application that cannot be rendered (ComparisonError, for example an expired registry token) and stays in Deleting is removed by clearing its Argo CD finalizer; false: the run fails with APPLICATION_NOT_REMOVED [Boolean]

finalBackup.description: Full backup of each Running instance before deletion: true, false or required [Enum]
